empty-description: Install a presence from the library.
settings-group-appearance-description: Theme, interface language, and background animation.
settings-group-activity-selection-descri: Choose how the shown presence is picked.
settings-group-schedule-description: Schedule when Nowly shares your activity.
settings-group-developer-description: Logs, local presences, and advanced tools.
discord-native-description: Discord shows {name} if you link your account. Nowly does the same without that link.
uninstall-confirm: Uninstall {name}? You can reinstall it from the library.
language-description: Use your browser's language by default, or choose a specific language for Nowly.
presence-language-description: Choose one language for every localized presence, or configure each presence separately.
bulk-uninstall-confirm: Uninstall {count} presences? If any contain configuration data, it will be permanently lost.
check-updates-description: Look for new versions of your installed presences.
store-install-queued: Install queued. Nowly will retry when the API is back.
home-search-empty: No installed presence matches this search.
presence-pause-description: Stop sending Rich Presence to Discord until you resume. Installed presences keep running.
api-base-url-description: Override the default API URL for self-hosted instances.
snooze-description: Temporarily pause sending activity to Discord.
schedule-description: Set days and times when this presence can show on Discord.
schedule-feature-description: When on, schedules hide Rich Presence outside the chosen days and hours. Buttons stay on each presence.
activity-selection-mode-description: Choose which active presence Discord shows when several tabs are running one at the same time.
activity-priority-order-description: Drag to reorder: the highest active presence wins, no matter which tab is focused.
activity-selection-locked-hint: Install at least two presences to choose how Discord picks which one to show.
developer-mode-description: Show diagnostic tools, analytics logs, and advanced settings.
developer-onboarding-reset-description: Reopen the onboarding and reset only the analytics decision. Installed presences and Nowly Host stay untouched.
local-zip-description: Zip a built presence (metadata.json + bundle.js). Use nowly pack <slug>. Unsigned zips only work on an unpacked (Load unpacked) build, not a Chrome Web Store install.
local-zip-invalid: This file is not a zip.
local-zip-unpacked-only: Local zip install only works on an unpacked extension. Load a development build from chrome://extensions, then drop the zip again.
onboarding-step-extension-success: The Nowly extension is installed and this panel is ready.
onboarding-step-user-scripts-success: User scripts are active. Nowly can run installed presences.
onboarding-step-user-scripts-error: Enable user scripts on the extension page, then come back here.
onboarding-user-scripts-gate-body: This permission lets Nowly run your installed presences on supported sites.
onboarding-user-scripts-gate-privacy: Nowly only runs presences you install and does not inspect pages without an active presence.
onboarding-step-host-error: Nowly Host is not detected. Install it, then click “Check connection”.
onboarding-step-host-chromeos-message: Nowly Host needs a native app that ChromeOS can't run today. We're looking into it.
onboarding-step-discord-waiting: Finish installing Nowly Host first, then open Discord Desktop.
onboarding-step-presence-success: The YouTube presence is installed. You can run the test.
onboarding-step-presence-error: Install the YouTube presence from the Nowly library.
onboarding-step-presence-waiting: Connect Discord before installing the test presence.
onboarding-step-youtube-success: YouTube activity is detected. Now check your Discord status.
onboarding-step-youtube-error: Open a YouTube video, keep Discord Desktop open, then check that your status updates.
onboarding-ready-message: Everything is connected. Open a supported site and check your Discord status.
diagnostic-description: Each link is checked separately so you can see exactly what is missing.
diagnostic-extension-installed-message: The Nowly extension is active in this browser.
diagnostic-user-scripts-active-message: Presences can run on compatible websites.
diagnostic-user-scripts-missing-message: User scripts are not active. Enable them on the extension page.
schedule-idle-hint: A schedule may be hiding Discord activity right now.
diagnostic-discord-closed-message: Nowly Host is installed but Discord Desktop is not open.
diagnostic-presence-missing-message: No presence is installed. Install the YouTube presence to test Nowly.
diagnostic-activity-missing-message: No activity is detected. Install a presence, then open a compatible site.
diagnostic-activity-missing-youtube-mess: Presence installed. Open YouTube to start the test.
bg-animation-description: Subtle accent gradient in the background.
appearance-description: Choose a light or dark interface, or follow your system.
canary-theme-description: Toggle the Canary accent. Turn it off to preview the global build. Unpacked builds only.
theme-section-description: Customize the accent color of the extension.
analytics-consent-description: Off by default. Helps us see which presences and features are actually used - no browsing history or personal data.
analytics-consent-manage: View, export, or delete my data
runtime-logs-description: Visible when developer mode is enabled.
